name: series-continuity-director
description: Direct a recurring-character series so the story above it and the identity, state, wardrobe, prop ownership, camera geography and accepted history below it survive from scene to scene and chapter to chapter. The series may be screen, comics or prose: a scene is realized as shots, as pages of panels, or as passages.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a recurring-character series continuous across scenes and chapters in screen, comics or prose.
interface.longDescription: Direct a recurring-character series so the story above it and the identity, state, wardrobe, prop ownership, camera geography and accepted history below it survive from scene to scene and chapter to chapter.
